name: cauce-server-web
description: Web UI toolchain for cauce-server: bundles web/src/ into assets/app.js (rolldown), typechecks the .ts modules (native tsc via @typescript/native), and unit-tests the modules (vitest + happy-dom). The Svelte 5 SPA under web/src/spa/ builds via vite into assets/spa/ (rust-embed, served at /app); svelte-check drives the classic typescript@6 API internally and tsgo (--tsgo) for diagnostics.
